title: Search multiple locations for required objects
description: Use when a task requires collecting multiple instances of the same object type.
content: When searching for multiple objects of the same type, check all plausible locations systematically rather than expecting them to be in one place. Objects may be found on different surfaces or containers, so continue exploring other rooms and surfaces after finding the first instance.

source.task_query: Your task is to: find two toiletpaper and put them in drawer.

title: Retry failed take actions after examining the location
description: Use when a take action fails despite the object appearing in the observation.
content: If a take action returns "Nothing happens," first examine the location to confirm the object is still there, then retry the take action. The failure may be transient, and a subsequent attempt can succeed without changing location.

source.task_query: Your task is to: find two toiletpaper and put them in drawer.

title: Move only the currently held object to the target container
description: Use when placing multiple objects into a container, especially after already depositing one.
content: After moving an object to a container, that object is no longer in your inventory. When depositing a second object, reference the newly picked-up object in the move command, not the previously deposited one, to avoid a failed action.

source.task_query: Your task is to: find two toiletpaper and put them in drawer.

title: Locate target objects by systematically examining containers
description: Use when the target object is not visible on surfaces and you need to find it in storage.
content: When a required object is not found on countertops or basins, systematically examine drawers and other storage containers. The target object may be stored alongside unrelated items, so examine each container's contents before moving on.

source.task_query: Your task is to: clean some soapbar and put it in cabinet.

title: Clean objects at a sink basin before placing them
description: Use when a task requires cleaning an object before delivering it to a destination.
content: After picking up the object to be cleaned, go to a sink basin and use the clean action with that basin. The cleaning action becomes available only when you are at the sink basin with the object in hand.

source.task_query: Your task is to: clean some soapbar and put it in cabinet.

title: Open closed cabinets before placing items inside
description: Use when the destination cabinet is closed and you need to put an object into it.
content: Before moving an object into a cabinet, check whether the cabinet is open. If it is closed, open it first; then the move action can be used to place the object inside.
